states: Production-built Pulse App with isolated loopback responses, compared with assigned main at the same desktop Chromium light and phone WebKit dark anchors (Playwright 1.56.1).

During the initial check and a later explicit reload, plan and membership replies arrived while the directory remained pending. Baseline shows placeholders; revised view names the workspace and offers a visible Restart billing check without rendering partial plan data.

The same current denial still hides the snapshot. The existing list_failed degradation retains accepted plan, member count and usage, with Organizations unavailable and Reload billing still reachable. A complete response restores the verified organization and member counts.
Twelve before/after screenshot pairs inspected. Phone touch target is 44 CSS px high at 390×844, the workspace wraps within the panel, and the normal settled fields and controls keep their positions.
interactions: Keyboard activation on desktop and touch in WebKit. Explicit reload moves lost focus to Restart while waiting. Focus stays on the surviving Reload action after a degraded result and continues to Billing & Usage on complete recovery.

Restart replaced the held request before it replied. In all four after journeys the retired directory request closed without a reply. Eight journeys, 84 checks, no unexpected scope changes, no mutations and no page errors.
